items.heading: Cachupa
details: Key ingredients: corn, beans, cassava, pork or fish, vegetables
Soak dried corn and beans overnight, then simmer them for hours until tender.
Add chunks of cassava, sweet potato and other vegetables.
Stir in pork or fish and season well.
Simmer until everything melds into a thick, hearty stew.

items.heading: Pastel com Diabo Dentro
details: Key ingredients: flour dough, tuna, onion, tomato, chili
Make a simple pastry dough and roll it thin.
Fill with a spicy, well-seasoned tuna and vegetable mixture.
Fold the dough over the filling and seal the edges.
Deep-fry until crisp and golden brown.
